::: {.callout-important title="How to submit"}
- Write your answers on paper or in a document. Show your steps.
- Upload **one** PDF or clear photos to the university e-learning platform.
- Due: **Week 2, before the first lecture**. Late work loses marks (see the syllabus).
- Work alone. You may ask questions in class.
:::

**Your number n** = the last digit of your student number. If it is 0, use 10.
Some tasks use n, so every student has different numbers.

## Task 1 · Easy (2 marks)

A short task from lesson A. Same words as the lessons.

## Task 2 · Use it (3 marks)

A task with numbers. Use **n** where you can.

## Task 3 · In a game (3 marks)

A real game situation (PLO of the ILO): a player, an enemy, a level, a phone.

## Task 4 · Think (2 marks)

Explain in 1–2 short sentences. No long essays.

## Before you submit {.checklist}

- My name and student number are on the first page.
- I answered every task and showed my steps.
- I used **my** number n.
